title: Recurrence Addition: Community Rules & Site Care Training Q&A
content:
Under Community Rules & Site Care, a recurrence addition is made to the repeat-violation charge by the cure outcomes recorded on the plan record as cured by the resident or cured by the community within recent calendar months ending on the handling date, the notice's own outcome included and a withdrawn notice never counted:

- two or more such outcomes within the 2 calendar months ending on the handling date: an addition of $25.00;
- fewer than two within those 2 months, but two or more within the 4 calendar months ending on the handling date: an addition of $10.00;
- otherwise no addition.

## Questions and answers

**Which outcomes are counted?** Outcomes recorded as cured by the resident and outcomes recorded as cured by the community. A notice withdrawn — as the plan's responsibility or on appeal — is never counted.

**Is the notice's own outcome counted?** Yes, the notice's own outcome is included.

**Hypothetical cases.**

| Counted outcomes recorded before the handling date | Within 2 months | Within 4 months | Addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 weeks and 6 weeks before | 2 | 2 | $25.00 |
| 5 weeks and 3 months before | 1 | 2 | $10.00 |
| 5 weeks before only | 1 | 1 | none |
| 3 and 5 months before | 0 | 1 | none |

A third outcome recorded 4 weeks before the handling date as withdrawn on appeal changes none of these rows.
